title: Tesla Wall Connector bootloader bypasses the firmware downgrade ratchet
summary: Security researchers at Synacktiv detail their findings on bypassing the firmware downgrade protection mechanism (ratchet) in Tesla Wall Connector's bootloader. This is the second part of a series exploring hardware vulnerabilities in the charging infrastructure through the charge port connector interface.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how hardware security mechanisms in consumer EV charging equipment can be circumvented, exposing attack surfaces in widely deployed IoT devices.
why_valuable: Reveals critical security vulnerabilities in Tesla's charging infrastructure that could help manufacturers improve secure boot implementations across the EV industry.
